newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India shares drift in torpid trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India shares drift in torpid trade.

text.p: Indian global depository shares were little changed Friday in lethargic trading, traders said.
"Its been very inactive, a but of a dull sort of week," a trader said.
GDRs retreated in late afternoon, traders said.
"A few things started to come off at the close, a little profit taking happening. But there are still firm undertones," one trader said.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.06 points higher at 89.13, or 0.06 percent, with the premium over the local market at 27.87 percent from 29.79 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index fell 5.94 points to 4.083.04.
State Bank of India fell 70 cents to $25.75/$26.500 and Bajaj Auto lost 12 cents to $36.00/$37.50.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed up 0.44 points, or 0.57 percent, to 78.15 points, a premium of 43.35 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 1.79 points higher, a gain of 1.44 percent, to 125.52, representing a discount to the local market of 3.95 percent.
